state.seed_assertion: Controllers should seek views of data subjects or their representatives on intended processing when appropriate, without prejudice to protection of commercial interests, public interests or security of operations.

sentences.1: Controllers should seek views of data subjects or their representatives on intended processing when appropriate, without prejudice to protection of commercial interests, public interests or security of operations.
sentences.2: Where appropriate, the controller shall seek the views of data subjects or their representatives on the intended processing, without prejudice to the protection of commercial or public interests or the security of processing operations.
sentences.3: The controller should seek the views of data subjects or their representatives on the intended processing when appropriate, without prejudice to the protection of commercial or public interests or the security of processing operations.
sentences.4: Where appropriate, the controller shall seek the views of data subjects or their representatives on the intended processing, without prejudice to the protection of commercial or public interests or the security of processing operations.
sentences.5: Legal advice or advice from independent experts such as IT experts, sociologists or ethicists should be considered where appropriate, though there are no specific requirements to do so.
sentences.6: We also recommend you consider seeking legal advice or advice from other independent experts such as IT experts, sociologists or ethicists where appropriate.
sentences.7: You can take into account the costs and benefits of each measure when deciding whether or not they are appropriate.
sentences.8: In appropriate cases we may issue a formal warning or take action to ban the processing altogether.
sentences.9: The advice and recommendations of the DPO should be recorded in a DPIA where relevant and the DPIA should be signed off by appropriate people.
